title: Jada's Dare
meta_description: Gulf Views, Steps From Beach Access- Jada's Dare by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Jada’s Dare by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 90 High Dune Drive Details: Jada’s Dare is a luxurious coastal retreat located in the private Gulf Trace neighborhood of Grayton Beach. Offering approximately 3,476 square feet of interior living space and an additional 865 square feet of outdoor living, this spacious home comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests with five bedrooms, five full baths, and one half bath. Thoughtfully designed interiors, generous gathering spaces, and expansive Gulf views create an exceptional setting for families and groups looking to experience the beauty of 30A. Outside, enjoy the private heated saltwater pool, multiple covered porches, and beautiful views of the Gulf. Surrounded by Grayton Beach State Park, Gulf Trace offers a peaceful coastal setting with approximately one mile of undisturbed shoreline. Private neighborhood beach access is just 50 steps from the home, making it easy to spend your days along the sugar-white sand and emerald waters. With its private pool, Gulf views, and exceptional location, Jada’s Dare provides an inviting retreat in one of Grayton Beach’s most sought-after neighborhoods. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Approximately 50 Steps to Private Neighborhood Beach Access -Parking Spaces: (2) in Carport and (6) in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available: Drip Coffee Maker -Private Heated Saltwater Pool* -Expansive Gulf Views -Covered Porches -Wet Bar with Wine Chiller and Separate Ice Maker -Outdoor Foot Wash -Outdoor Gas Grill *Pool heat is available for an additional $60 (pre-tax) per night and must be arranged prior to arrival. *Pool heating is not recommended when ambient temperatures fall below 50 degrees, as the heater may be unable to reach the desired temperature. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 10 5 Bedrooms / 5.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower, Double Vanity, Walk-In Closet) and Partial Gulf View -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) and Gulf View -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) and Gulf View -Kitchen / Living Room / Dining Area -Wet Bar with Wine Chiller and Separate Ice Maker -Laundry Room -Half Bath -Covered Porches Second Floor: -Bedroom 4: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Walk-In Shower) and Gulf View -Bedroom 5: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) and Gulf View Please Note: *LSVs and on-street parking are strictly prohibited within the Gulf Trace neighborhood. *There are large homes under construction along the beach in front of Jada’s Dare and elsewhere in the neighborhood. Construction may obstruct Gulf views and may result in construction-related activity during your stay. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
